d: Nisha bhagat ke parijnon se milne unke aavas pahunchin rashtriy mahila aayog ki adhyaksh vijya rahatkar, pita se mulakat kar vyakt ki sanvedna, doshiyon ke khilaph karravaee aur nisha ko nyay dilane ka diya bharosa. esaaaeeaar ko lekar 18 navanbar ko rajy ke sabhi matdan kendron par lagega ek aur avsar kainp, mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ne kaha- patr matdataon ko matdata suchi men nam jurvane ka milega ek aur mauka. chhath mahaparv ko lekar rajyabhar men taiyariyan tej, relve ki or se yatriyon ki suvidha ke lie kie ja rahe vishesh intjam, chhath ghaton aur talabon men yuddhastar par…
